description:
Goal
Close the work by deleting obsolete vocabulary, updating docs/guides, and pinning telemetry that proves the single-spine model.

Required docs
Update outline.md or its successor to use ShapeId/LaneId/CallableId, not ScalarId or LocalCallableId. Update .agent docs and user-facing guides touched by compiler2 runtime transport. Document: semantic evidence is not representation obligation; RuntimeDemand is pre-spine; Shape is settled once and interned all the way down; ValueId maps to ShapeId outside the spine; facts are tables; divergence is is_empty(return_ty); published boundary contracts are columns, not shape translations.

Telemetry signal
Expose stable counts for shape nodes, Nothing nodes, lane leaves, tuple nodes, callable nodes, direct callable transports, first-class callable materializations, boundary publications, omitted lanes, and codegen lanes. Tests should assert intent through telemetry where that is less brittle than structure dumps.

Removal target
Dead TODOs, stale comments saying RuntimeValueLayout is the authority, stale tests asserting RuntimeValueLayout/DeliveredShape, compatibility switches, old dump sidecars, and any temporary construction affordance. If anything temporary remains, create a follow-up ticket before closing this one.

Checks
cargo test --workspace or the agreed compiler2 matrix; cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings; rg confirms removed old-world names are absent or only appear in historical notes that explicitly describe the removed model.
title: Transport spine: delete old vocabulary, update docs, and pin LaneId telemetry
